author: Jason Stys
summary: Review two manually authored keyframes using conservative privacy envelopes with private revision and export checks.
rationale: Makes redaction planning reproducible and keeps manual assumptions visible rather than claiming automatic recognition or tracking.
limitations: Two manually authored rectangle keyframes and linear assumptions, not automatic detection, recognition or identity tracking.
Nonlinear movement or contextual identifiers require every-frame human review; envelopes can over-mask and do not certify anonymity.
Workspace protection trusts the local OS owner; no real sensitive footage or operational surveillance validation is claimed.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
